text:
emily: Heads up — OBS dropped the stream for ~28s during setup, saw "stream disconnected" right before CEO Q&A. Thinking we should move CEO after product updates. @mike @sophia can you confirm? Log: ERROR socket timeout 10.44.0.12:4444
mike: Looking. Pinging infra and recorder. @deploy-bot can you give recorder pod status?
deploy-bot: ah-recorder-2 restarted at 2615432120, prev CrashLoop -> Running, uptime 55s, health=OK
andre: If the recorder missed audio we can splice local mixer backup. @rachael do you have it?
rachael: Yep grabbed it, uploading to Drive now — will post link in #ops-assets when ready
sam: I can do a quick splice and produce a patched meeting file 10m after end. Need sign-off to shuffle CEO slot. Sample ffmpeg command I'm planning to use (dry-run):
``
ffmpeg -i meeting_main.mp4 -i allhands_backup_2026-03-23.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -shortest stitched_output.mp4
```
sophia: Leadership prefers moving the CEO to after product segment. @rachael did upload finish?
rachael: Upload complete. Drive: https://drive.google.com/placeholder filename: allhands_backup_2026-03-23.wav size: 12.3MB
mike: Infra traced a transient egress flake in us-west, we routed stream to secondary egress and scaled recorder canary. Captions stayed live.
emily: Good — I'll announce the agenda tweak in 45s. No viewer reports so far.
sam: Will run the splice locally and share preview link once ready. ETA ~8m.
andre: Please add this to incidents list for a short postmortem — tags: allhands, recorder, network-egress.
emily: Added to incident backlog and created follow-up doc in Drive.
sophia: Q&A triage: we have 6 queued questions; I'll surface top 3 live and submit the rest into the follow-up doc. @chris ok with CEO at 11:05?
chris: Confirmed. Move CEO to 11:05, announce in #all-hands, and don't publish final meeting notes until stitched recording verified. Thanks all. ❤️
emily: Announced: "CEO fireside moved to 11:05 due to minor setup hiccup. We'll patch audio and publish the full recording after the meeting." :loudspeaker:
mike: :thumbsup:
rachael: Backup retained in cloud for 30 days; kept original WAV + 16-bit copy.
emily: Closing thread unless anything else pops up — great recovery team, filing infra/recorder follow-ups.
